comparison.objective: Place shielding bricks on computed lines between hot vials and a seat, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Geometric placement and an inter-arm brick handover differ from precision tool access, screw manipulation, collar tuning, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Success requires one upright brick near each vial without touching or moving the vials; the candidate requires two repeatable bounded impacts after relocking.
comparison.reason: Radiation-layout reasoning and shielding placement do not test adjustable-mechanism commissioning.
